summary: Completed comprehensive backend regression testing of VideoForge AI. All 18 requested features verified across 25 pytest tests with 100% pass rate including full pipeline: auth (register/login/me + guards), trends (AI + cache), projects CRUD, script generation via GPT-4o-mini, OpenAI TTS voice, GPT Image 1 thumbnail, mocked YouTube publish (immediate + scheduled), analytics summary, series bulk creation, voices list, and tools comparison.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~715 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, projects.py, ai_services.py, analytics.py) before it grows further.

Voice endpoint returns full base64 mp3 in JSON response (~1MB+). For production, consider streaming or uploading to object storage and returning a URL to reduce payload size and JSON parsing overhead.

Thumbnail endpoint similarly embeds full base64 PNG in response and persists it in MongoDB, which will bloat the projects collection. Recommend storing as a separate asset (GridFS / S3) and saving only the URL on the project document.
get_current_user: uses Depends(security) where security=HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) - correctly returns 401 for missing creds (verified). Good.
Trends cache: the 6h TTL check is correct, but there is no index on db.trends_cache.key. Add a unique index on 'key' for fast lookups at scale.
No index on db.projects.user_id or db.users.email - add unique index on users.email and compound index (user_id, created_at) on projects for production readiness.
analytics_summary does an `import hashlib` inside the function; move to top-level imports.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec - browsers will reject credentialed requests. Set specific origins in production.
JWT_SECRET has a default fallback 'change-me' - should raise on startup if missing in production.
Series endpoint silently falls back to placeholder topics on LLM failure without surfacing the error to the caller; consider returning a flag so UI can communicate degraded mode.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own TEST_-prefixed projects/users and cleans up after itself. The persisted analytics/projects for the pipeline test user remain (expected - analytics test requires at least 1 published project).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_videoforge_backend.py is the canonical regression. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Test data is TEST_-prefixed. Trends cache is 6h so second call asserts cached=True (warm-up call included). Pipeline test takes ~60s total due to real LLM (script), TTS (voice), and GPT Image 1 (thumbnail, 30-90s) calls.
